title: Zesty Roasted Ethiopian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Ethiopian lamb stew featuring allspice and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a diabetic-friendly dinner option
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the ground allspice, cumin, coriander, and red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb, chicken broth, and salt and pepper to taste, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven, where it will braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot over rice or injera bread.
